task.title: See the events of a person
task.shortdesc: List what happened in a person's life, such as birth, marriage and death, and open any one.

prereq.p: Open a person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Choose in the list on the left.

stepresult.p: Each event has a line with its name, its date and its place. A small number at the right counts the sources for it, once it has one.

step.cmd: Choose an event to open it.

stepresult.p: A page shows its type, date and place. It has a count of sources, a row of photo buttons, and the buttons and .

step.cmd: Choose at the top to go back to the list.

result.p: To add an event, choose under the list.
